Local Vita changes: native vitaGL headers/version mapping; tracked mipmap filter; explicit errors for APIs unused by ONScripter-RU that vitaGL does not expose.
Native integration also fixes physical target viewports/scissors, virtual target copies, pitch-safe upload/readback, and tracked mipmap filter state.
Native startup also logs default shader stages and honors shader link failures before selecting a program.
Native compiler diagnostics use the vitaShaRK public callback and log failed translated source before shader deletion.
